shared_elements: human figure in profile, low relief
bearded male figure with elaborate coiffure/headgear
arm extended forward with open hand
attendant/genie type figure carrying or handling an object
stylized plant/rosette motif (bucket and floral elements)
figures oriented toward a focal point
justification: Both show bearded male figures in flat, profile low relief with the same conventions: patterned fringed robes, heavy bracelets, muscular outlined arms extended forward, and accompanying paraphernalia (a handled bucket and rosette-covered stylised plant) that belong to the same specific iconographic repertoire. The main differences are that B's central figure is winged and reaching toward a plant filling the field, while A shows an unwinged procession of several full-length figures in a horizontal band with one carrying a bucket.
